meta.name: baoyu-url-to-markdown
meta.description: Fetch any URL and convert to markdown using Chrome CDP. Supports two modes - auto-capture on page load, or wait for user signal (for pages requiring login). Use when user wants to save a webpage as markdown.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意网页转为 Markdown 格式保存
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要把网页内容保存为 Markdown 格式
copy.tagline_en: Convert any webpage to Markdown format
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to save web pages as Markdown

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 能抓取指定网址的网页，用 Chrome 浏览器引擎把网页内容转成干净的 Markdown 文件，并附上标题、网址等元信息。支持自动抓取和等待用户确认后再抓取两种模式，后者适用于需要登录的页面。
howto.when: 当用户给出网址并想把它存成 Markdown 文件时触发；也适用于用户要求抓取网页内容并转换的场合。

say.note: 自动模式，页面加载完即抓取。

say.text: 抓取这个网址并保存到文件：https://example.com

say.note: 应对需要登录或懒加载的页面。

howto.what_en: Fetches a given URL via Chrome CDP and converts the webpage to clean Markdown with front-matter metadata. Supports auto-capture on page load and wait-for-user mode for login-required pages.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to save a webpage as Markdown, or provides a URL and asks to convert it.

say_en.text: Convert this webpage to Markdown: https://example.com
say_en.note: Auto mode captures after page load.

say_en.text: Fetch this URL and save to a file: https://example.com
say_en.note: You can specify an output path.

say_en.text: Wait until the page is ready, then capture: https://example.com
